statement: Marvell and Google expanded a custom-silicon commercial agreement backed by a Google warrant whose vesting is tied to Custom Products revenue tranches implying a cumulative ceiling of roughly $120 billion.
why: A hyperscaler tying equity vesting to its own custom-accelerator purchases signals a durable, large-scale shift of AI compute spend toward in-house silicon rather than merchant GPUs.

impact.mechanism: Google-funded custom inference accelerators, NICs and memory-interface parts substitute for merchant GPU attach in the TPU ecosystem, expanding ASIC/networking-silicon volume while capping merchant-GPU share of that spend.

evidence.excerpt: with one tranche vesting for each $500 million in Custom Products revenue -- implying a potential cumulative revenue ceiling of approximately $120 billion
AI inference accelerators, storage, networking and memory interface controllers, and near memory computing technologies for Google.

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet relaying SEC 8-K terms; no separately fetched filing or second publisher, so capped at medium.
